guidance.title: Guidance & where to go next
guidance.body: This page gives organisation-level farming guidance, not a reading from your field. Use it to plan irrigation and crop care, then confirm anything important before acting on it.
guidance.pointSensor: No weather, soil or moisture sensors are connected in this deployment.
guidance.pointAi: Disease and health checks are AI-assisted predictions, not a confirmed diagnosis.
guidance.pointConfirm: When symptoms persist or a decision is costly, consult your local agriculture extension officer.
guidance.orgNote: All figures on this page come from records you entered in Kisan Mitra.
guidance.assistantSub: Describe your crop and field, and ask about irrigation timing.
guidance.helpSub: Learn how to add crops and manage reminders.
